children.description: Studies of the cultures, societies, and empires of ancient civilizations such as Egypt, Greece, and Rome
Examines the period between the fall of the Roman Empire and the Renaissance, including the rise of Christianity and feudalism
Explores the significant changes that occurred during the Industrial Revolution and the rise of European empires in the 18th and 19th centuries
Covers major events and developments from the 20th century to the present day, including World War I and II, the Cold War, and global conflict
Focuses on understanding map reading and navigation, including interpreting maps, analyzing geographic data, and understanding geographic projections
Studies the relationship between human societies and the physical environment, including economic activities, trade, and the impact of human activity on the environment
Examines the movement and distribution of people, including urbanization, immigration, and migration patterns, and their impact on the environment
Investigates the ways in which culture is shaped by and influences the physical environment, including the relationship between culture and identity
